description:
Talk between girls regarding the desire to hide in the rectum of the person you like (in other words, wanting to be together forever).

If you begin to think that you might as well dedicate yourself completely to the other person, you become tempted to devour the other person whole. Without knowing their true feelings you are at their mercy.In this situation there is a swirling of various emotions such as yearning, possessiveness, jealousy, and guilt. Constantly having him on my mind, at this rate what will come of me?!

(Source: Official Youtube Channel)
